label: Garden Kit
description: Two nodes for Olive’s Island (the bot-garden template), no backend and no network: Block List (a nested, draggable block program a child edits with a finger, a pen or a mouse — tap a palette block to add, drag to move, tap the cross to remove, minus and plus on a repeat's count, a picker of garden words on an ask block; emits the program as JSON on every edit and glows the block the graph names) and Garden (a tile world from rows of characters and a legend, tulips dry or watered, puddles, letters, bowls, stones, eggs, food, a flag, a post box tile, and one or two robots that glide, turn, bump and speak; every sprite inline SVG). The kit draws; the engine decides.
